site.title: Multi-User Video Call
site.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/158.0.8127.18 Safari/537.36
site.domainNote: browser-based multi-user video conferencing room (WebRTC demo-style) with side chat

view.name: Call room with chat pane
view.description: Video call room with the navbar controls and the open chat pane showing the team's sync messages and a message composer.

regions.label: Teal top bar: 'Video Call' title, Unique Identifier string, six icon call-control buttons (camera, mic, share screen, record, chat toggle, leave)
Large white video stage; no participant tiles rendered in capture, small blank self-view video at bottom-left
Teal 'CHAT' side panel with wheat-colored message boxes (text, sender + ID, timestamp) and a textarea + Send composer

evidence.note: Call controls: Hide Video, Mute, Share screen, Record, chat toggle, leave (link to /)
Chat side channel; chat icon in top bar toggles it (verified live)

evidence.quote: Okay I think that's everything. Thanks everyone, great sprint. Notes will be in #tidewater-team in 10 min
evidence.note: Stacked uniform message boxes, sender name with ID and timestamp under each message
Composer form at bottom of thread
Multi-line textarea with italic placeholder, no label
Hovering icon buttons shows no rendered tooltip (only accessible names / possibly native title)
Chat panel is a docked side column toggled by the chat button, not an overlay sliding drawer

structure.layout: full-viewport app: fixed top bar with call controls, wide video stage on left (~75%), fixed-width chat column on right with internal scrolling message list and composer

aesthetics.typography: System font stack (-apple-system / Helvetica/Arial fallback) everywhere: title and identifier in nav, 'CHAT' heading, message bodies, metadata, Send button
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat: 32px regular 'CHAT' heading; 16px nav title/identifier and Send; 12px message body; 10px sender/timestamp metadata. No bold weights.

notes: Bootstrap 'info' teal (#17a2b8) top bar and chat column; messages are wheat (#f5deb3) 6px-rounded boxes with 1px border, all left-aligned regardless of sender, metadata line format 'Name (__id__id__) - 17th November, 2026 10:34 pm'. Links in messages render as raw blue URLs, no previews. Video stage empty/white in capture. Header icon buttons are Font Awesome filled glyphs in white. Send button is dark gray (#343a40) square block flush to the textarea. Chat panel scrolls internally; full screenshot expanded it to 5400px.
